memoryRule: a broadcast borrows a phase from one cube, changes its seam, moves a non-adjacent echo, and leaves phase debt for the next transfer
interactionRule: ArrowLeft and ArrowRight choose a signal without writing history; Enter, Space, or the broadcast control commits one bounded event; pointer taps are refused; Delete lifts the latest; Escape or R releases the loom
representationRupture: signal field -> one faceted cube loom with carrier seams and remote phase echoes
encounterRupture: passive proximity -> lane selection followed by a committed broadcast
temporalRupture: simultaneous crowd response -> bounded phase debt inherited by later broadcasts
mediumRupture: Canvas crowd geometry -> WebGPU-ready cube loom with deterministic Canvas fallback
renderer: WebGPU cube loom with Canvas geometry fallback
promotion: candidate / held pending browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
